name: fetchguard
description: Runtime content-level injection scanner: a PostToolUse hook (matcher WebFetch|WebSearch) that scans the tool_response text for planted prompt-injection phrasings (concealment / verification-bypass / instruction-override / egress) and, on a hit or an undecidable response, injects additionalContext telling the model the flagged span is untrusted DATA whose embedded directives must NOT be followed.
